title: UIActionHistory
description: Payload schema for the `nodemedic.cf.newrelic.com/ui-action-history` annotation written by the NodeMedic On-Call UI to the NodeHealthDiagnosisAI custom resource. The annotation value is a JSON-encoded array of UIActionEntry objects, capped at 20 entries (FIFO ring buffer — appending the 21st drops index 0). See spec.md §6 (FR-18, FR-18a) and data-model.md §3.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the UI invoked the action.

actor.description: Identifier of the human (or system) that initiated the action. For v1 always the literal string `demo-anonymous` per spec §0 Q6 — UI is anonymous behind kubectl port-forward. SSO restoration adds a real user identifier here.

result.description: High-level outcome. `ok` — action applied. `reclaimed` — node not found at action time (FR-17a). `error` — apiserver returned a non-200 we couldn't recover from. `partial` — drain only; some pods evicted, some skipped/errored. NOTE: the `no-change` idempotent path (already-uncordoned, annotation already cleared) does NOT write an audit entry — see FR-14 / FR-15.

detail.description: Human-readable summary line. For drain: `evicted=12 skipped=3 errored=1`. For uncordon: empty. For errors: truncated apiserver error text.
